declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.reachable_route_is_enumerated
declarations.type: initial coverage and successor closure enumerate every adaptively reachable route

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.adaptive_frontier_covers_reachable_route
declarations.type: a frontier over an adaptively closed catalog covers every reachable route

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.reachably_undominated_route_is_retained
declarations.type: catalog soundness makes every reachably undominated route retained

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.discovered_route_is_reachable
declarations.type: an evidence-enabled successor is inductively reachable

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.static_frontier_covers_incomplete_catalog
declarations.type: a static frontier can validly cover every member of an incomplete catalog

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.static_frontier_misses_reachable_route
declarations.type: a static frontier over an incomplete catalog can miss a reachable route

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.incomplete_catalog_is_not_successor_closed
declarations.type: a catalog omitting an evidence-enabled successor is not successor closed

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdaptiveCatalogClosure.initial_coverage_does_not_imply_adaptive_coverage
declarations.type: initial-route coverage alone does not imply adaptive route coverage
